 Where the ad money goes
 You pay for the click. The page decides the rest. 
 1 What you are paying for
 You are paying for clicks or a monthly fee and cannot see what it buys. Or you have a good business and a site that undersells it.
 2 Where it leaks
 Paid clicks in Farnham are expensive. If the page they land on does not turn visits into calls, every month of ad spend leaks money.
 3 What fixes it
 A site built to turn visits into calls, with a clear price and one person to talk to.

 How the build works
 From first look to first call 
 01 Look at the spend
 Andy goes through where your visits come from and what the page asks them to do, then puts a fixed scope in writing.
 02 Build for the call
 He writes and designs each section around one action, with the phone number and form close at hand, and you review it first.
 03 Launch and track
 It goes live on your domain with form and call clicks tracked, so you can see what the spend is producing.

 Who builds it
 The web designer Farnham firms speak to directly 
 Andy Norman designs and builds every site himself from his base in Andover, after more than 30 years in field service and managed print.
 He does not run your ads. His job is the page they land on, and giving a paid visit a clear reason to become a phone call. Most of the work happens by phone and video.

 Before you spend more
 Questions from Farnham firms paying for traffic 
 Is Wrecclesham or Frensham too far out for you?
 Yes, and wider Surrey, including Rowledge, Tilford and Hale.
 Will the site work with my Google Ads?
 Yes. It gets clear landing sections, a fast page and tracked form and call clicks. Andy does not manage the ad account itself, so that stays with you or whoever runs it now.
 Can I see examples?
 Yes. The previews on this page show We Plumb It, a live client site, alongside demo builds. There is no written case study published yet, so those previews are the best way to judge the work.
 What would a Farnham website cost?
 It is £600 fixed for five pages or £995 for eight, and each page past that is £125. Once it is live, hosting and care comes to £10 a month.
 How long will the build take?
 Expect 1 to 3 weeks once your deposit is in. Any ads you are running can carry on until the new pages are ready, then be pointed at them.
 Do I keep the site if I stop paying for ads?
 Your ad spend and your website are separate. You own the site once it is paid for.
 Does a new site mean I can drop the ads?
 Not straight away, and possibly not at all. Technical SEO and schema are set up in every build, but search visibility takes time, so the honest answer depends on your market.

## https://farnhamwebsitedesign.co.uk/about-andy

The person building your pages
 Andy Norman, building pages that get the call 
 Andy spent over 30 years in field service and managed print before moving into websites, finishing as a service manager. That work teaches you to ask what a bill actually paid for.
 If your Farnham budget is going out and the phone is not ringing enough, he looks at the page first, because that is the part he can fix.
 How he thinks about a paid visit
 Somebody clicking an advert has already shown interest. What matters then is whether the page answers their question quickly and makes the next step obvious, and that is what each section is written to do.
